headline: GTA 6 countdown: 7 days to go
title: GTA 6 Countdown 7 Days Left | 101 million | Vice City Is Back
video_script: Only 7 days until GTA 6. The first trailer passed 101 million views in just two days. Grand Theft Auto 6 comes out on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Are you playing it on day one? Comment below!
joke: Most of those views were probably me pressing replay.
description: GTA 6 countdown - 7 days to go. The first trailer passed 101 million views in just two days. Grand Theft Auto VI launches on 19 November 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Facts from Rockstar's announcements as summarised on Wikipedia.
